Nothing needs a schema change, so there are no migrations. This comes from `docs/flows/add-endpoint.md`, which uses this exact feature as its example. I didn't open the code, so the line numbers are the docs' anchors and I haven't checked them. ## Worker (`worker/`) | File | Change | |---|---| | `src/types/index.ts` | Add a `RestBody { sessionId, characterId }` type. Add a cost constant such as `REST_COST`. The value is yours to pick, because the docs don't define one. | | `src/routes/rest.ts` (new) | Export `restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with a `POST /`. The handler does the following:
• Validates the body.
• Calls `getCharacter`.
• Rejects the request if `gold < cost`.
• Calls `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })`. `services/character.ts:94` whitelists fields, and `hp` and `gold` are the ones needed.
• Returns `updatedCharacter`.
• Optionally calls `askDM` for narration, then `appendHistory` and `saveSession`, and inserts an `adventure_log` row. Use `routes/action.ts` as the template. | | `src/index.ts` (lines 41-48) | Import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`. CORS (lines 19-35) only changes if there is a new frontend origin, which there isn't. | | `src/services/*.ts` | Only if other routes will share the rest logic. Otherwise keep it in the route. | ## Frontend (`frontend/src/app/`) | File | Change | |---|---| | `models/game.models.ts` | Add a `RestResponse` interface that mirrors the Worker's response, including `updatedCharacter`. | | `services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)`, which POSTs to `${API_BASE}/api/rest`. | | `components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` and `.html` | Add a "Rest at Inn" button and a handler. The handler calls `rest()`, then `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)` so the sheet updates, then pushes a system or narrative entry. It should also show an error such as "not enough gold". Templates stay in the `.html` file, not inline. | | `components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts` | Add tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy: success, and insufficient gold. | `character-state.service.ts` shouldn't need changes, since `setCharacter` already exists. ## Docs to update in the same change (per `docs/AUTHORING.md`) - **New doc:** `worker/src/routes/rest.md`. - **Doc beside each changed file:** `types/index.md`, `worker/src/index.md`, `game.models.md`, `game-api.service.md` and `game-console.component.md`. - **`code.md`:** add the new doc, then re-run `research-work/scripts/build-symbol-index.mjs`. - **`docs/PRD.md` §9:** add the API spec. - **`docs/flows/inventory.md`:** possibly, if you want a rest flow documented. ## Things to watch - **Rules in the Worker:** the cost and the HP math stay there, and the AI only narrates. - **B-05:** potion healing is client-side only and never saved. Don't copy that pattern, because rest must persist through `updateCharacter`. - **Gold race:** the `gold` check and the write should happen in one handler, so the player can't double-spend.
